hero.title: The Gentlemen — Season 2
hero.format: series — season 2, 8 episodes, full binge drop
hero.about: Guy Ritchie's slick British crime series returns after a one-year time jump. Aristocrat Eddie Horniman and Susie Glass push Bobby's empire out from the English countryside to the Italian lakes while navigating a rocky romance and a widening underworld. All 8 eps drop at once.
hero.why: You rated The Gentlemen S1 at 4.5★, and this is the direct continuation from the same creator. Multiple taste levers at once — dry British humor, witty banter, quirky ensemble, dark humor with substance. Ritchie's tone is the closest cousin to Slow Horses / Spy on your Loved list. Full-drop lets you binge in 30–60 min chunks before bed.
